headings.usage: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight to tracking-tighter) for massive scale. Use font-black for problem statement numbers.

body.usage: Clean, highly legible text for all dashboard and marketing body copy.

mono.usage: Use for tracking numbers, orchestration logic (IF/THEN/AND), and small technical metadata.

surfaces.marketing_cards: Flat background (#F7F7F8) with 1px border (#E5E5EA), no shadow. On hover, slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow (shadow-lg).
surfaces.dashboard_panels: border-collapse style layout, stark white with sharp 1px borders, no rounded corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
surfaces.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 border-b border-gray-200/50. NEVER fully transparent.

treatments.photography: Spotlight effect or clipped frames. Never use full-bleed generic stock. Mask images into geometric shapes or architecturally aligned boxes.
treatments.lines: Use 1px vertical and horizontal dividing lines to create a 'Swiss Grid' architectural feel.

marketing.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 to py-32 for sections. Container must have internal padding.
marketing.bento_grid: Asymmetrical. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix spans (e.g., col-span-8, col-span-4).

dashboard.grid: High density grid. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.

motion.scrolling: Use lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is MANDATORY for the premium feel.
motion.kinetic_hero: Masked line-by-line reveal on load. Use framer-motion: overflow-hidden wrapper, child div animates y from 100% to 0 with custom cubic-bezier ease.
motion.parallax: Subtle framer-motion useScroll/useTransform for the hero image or map to move slightly slower than the scroll speed.
motion.micro_interactions: All buttons and interactive cards must have hover scales (scale 0.98 or 1.02) and color transitions.

media.maps: react-simple-maps for the interactive world shipment map. Use a clean, light SVG topology. Animated routes (SVG dasharray) and status markers.
media.icons: lucide-react for sharp, clean SaaS icons. 1.5 stroke width.

3d_libraries.name: react-simple-maps
3d_libraries.usage: 2D interactive map with animated SVG paths representing shipment routes. Lightweight, fits the clean SaaS aesthetic better than a heavy 3D globe.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the #F7F7F8 background meets 4.5:1 ratio. The orange accent (#FF4500) must only be used on white backgrounds for text or as a background with white text.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for the framer-motion reveals.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

hero_abstract.description: Clean minimalist white architectural corner, used for the abstract right-side visual in the hero.

cargo_ocean.description: Top-down aerial view of a cargo ship, used in the 'Multi-modal' section or 'Legs' visual.

warehouse_modern.description: Bright modern warehouse, used in the 'Who We Serve' or 'Manifesto' sections.

component_specific_treatments.manifesto_chapters: Massive typography. Number '01' in font-black text-gray-200. The title overlaps the number.
component_specific_treatments.editorial_marquee: react-fast-marquee. Use JetBrains Mono, text-sm, wide tracking. Pale gray background (#F7F7F8) with dark text. Very slow speed. Format: '+++ NEW YORK -> LONDON [IN TRANSIT] +++ TOKYO -> SF [DELIVERED]'
component_specific_treatments.event_normalization_visual: A diagram showing chaotic messy inputs ('Carrier A', 'Carrier B') flowing into a clean, sharp, orange-highlighted box: 'PICKED UP'.
component_specific_treatments.orchestration_rule_builder: A minimalist interactive component showing IF [Condition] AND [Condition] THEN [Action]. Use mono font for the logic keywords.
component_specific_treatments.shipment_timeline: Vertical stepped timeline. Use sharp 1px vertical lines. Status dots: orange for exceptions, blue for transit, green for delivered.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold. Ensure the design feels like a high-growth tech startup, not a boring traditional logistics firm.
Do NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'. Keep text mostly left-aligned.
Use glass-morphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) for the sticky header.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical (e.g., py-24 or py-32 for marketing sections).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent.files: You have .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write all components as .js or .jsx.
instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Build a hybrid app with React router. Routes: '/' (Marketing Landing Page), '/dashboard' (Control Tower Dashboard Demo), '/shipment/123' (Shipment Detail Demo).
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Use Tailwind CSS. Add Cabinet Grotesk (headings), Satoshi (body), and JetBrains Mono to index.css via font-face or Google Fonts imports.
instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Wrap key marketing sections in framer-motion <motion.div> for scroll reveals (whileInView). Implement the kinetic hero text reveal.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Use Shadcn UI for dashboard elements (Table, Cards, Badges, Tabs), but heavily strip down their styles to match the 'flat, 1px border' Swiss aesthetic. No heavy shadows.
instructions_to_main_agent.map: Use react-simple-maps on the homepage and dashboard to show shipment routes. Make it interactive (hover states on markers).
